description: This Java class 'RuleChainImportService' handles importing, updating, and managing RuleChain entities within the Thingsboard platform, including preparing data, checking for updates, saving entities, and logging actions.

classes.name: RuleChainImportService
classes.description: Service class for importing and managing RuleChain entities, extending BaseEntityImportService with specific logic for RuleChains.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the tenant ID as owner of the RuleChain.

methods.name: findExistingEntity
methods.description: Finds an existing RuleChain by ID or by name if not found by ID.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the RuleChain entity for import, including ID replacements and configuration adjustments.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the RuleChain entity in the database.

methods.name: isUpdateNeeded
methods.description: Determines if the existing RuleChain needs to be updated based on new data.

methods.name: onEntitySaved
methods.description: Logs the action performed on the entity after save or update.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the RuleChain entity.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is RULE_CHAIN.
